title: Knappis - My first game ever, developed together with my 3 year old
author: Wesztman
selftext:
https://i.redd.it/at8z8iq8yezh1.png

I could not find a simple enough game to let my 3 year old learn the gamepad, so me and him sat down with Opus 5.5 and developed one together 😊 very simple so far and it only works with Xbox controllers since that is what I had myself (and I want the images on screen to be exactly as the real controller so he knows what to do). You can set the walking speed and there are two game modes, "Free play": walk to the button and press it, "Find the button": go to the button indicated and press it 😊

[https://wesztman.github.io/knappis/](https://wesztman.github.io/knappis/)

Please go ahead and try it out with your kids, leave any feedback in the Github issues (link in the lower right corner of the game). PR:s with reasonable improvements are welcome 😊 

Cheers
